title: Beetroot pancakes
hookLine: Ukrainian-inspired beetroot pancakes with 11 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Whisk & Combine Base Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Put the beetroot in a jug with the milk and blend with a stick blender until smooth. Pour into a bowl with the rest of the pancake ingredients and whisk until smooth and vibrant purple. Incorporate {m53316_1}, {m53316_2}, {m53316_3}, and {m53316_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure beetroot first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Put a small knob of butter in a large non-stick frying pan and heat over a medium-low heat until melted and foamy. Now create 3 or 4 pancakes each made from 2 tbsp of the batter. Cook for 2-3 mins then flip over and cook for a further minute until cooked through. Repeat with any remaining batter. Heat oven to lowest setting and keep the pancakes warm in there until needed. Incorporate {m53316_5} and {m53316_6} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {m53316_7}, {m53316_8}, {m53316_9}, {m53316_10}, and {m53316_11} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Drain Crisp, Garnish & Serve Warm
steps.instructionTemplate: Serve with your favourite pancake toppings or make a simple compote by simmering frozen berries in with 1 tbsp blackcurrant jam until bubbling and syrupy (about 5-10 mins). In a small bowl stir together the remaining jam and the yogurt. Stack the cooked pancakes with the yogurt and pour the warm berry compote over the top.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Glaze or toss in sugar while still warm so the coating melts lightly and clings to every ridge.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 33 mins!
